description: 45th Parliament committee compositions for ETHI and NDDN. These are the two committees the campaign targets for formal studies.

ETHI.name: Standing Committee on Access to Information, Privacy and Ethics

members.name: Michael Barrett
members.note: CPC ethics critic. Called for Champagne-Alto ethics probe Feb 2026. ALREADY PRIMED. Primary target.

members.name: Leslie Church
members.note: CLEAN Liberal on ETHI. Potential recruit for P2 (foreign lobbying transparency) — framed as strengthening C-70.

members.name: Gabriel Hardy
members.note: CLEAN Quebec CPC freshman on ETHI. Prime P1 champion — new MP, clean record, Quebec riding.

vote_math.note: CPC chair + 3 CPC members + 1 Bloc = 5 opposition vs 3 Liberal. Opposition controls this committee. Any study request WILL pass if CPC + Bloc agree.

campaign_action.phase_4_study: Request ETHI study on lobbying concentration patterns (P2). Barrett already aggressive on ethics issues. CPC members will vote yes because it exposes Liberal lobbying. Bloc (Theriault) votes yes because Quebec nationalist positioning. Study passes 5-3.
campaign_action.target_mp: Michael Barrett — send him the sector lobbying analysis + CIJA deep scan + Carney conflicts. He's the CPC ethics critic who ALREADY called for the Champagne probe. He will push for the broader lobbying study.
campaign_action.secondary_target: Luc Theriault (Bloc vice-chair) — send the full lobbying data with Quebec framing. 'Ottawa's lobbying machine bypasses Quebec interests.'

chair.name: Charles Sousa
chair.note: CLEAN Liberal chairing NDDN. Unusual: the chair is clean while the CPC vice-chair (Bezan) is flagged. Sousa could be recruited for P5 with 'clean military oversight' framing.

vice_chairs.name: James Bezan
vice_chairs.note: Long-serving CPC defence critic. Primary target for revolving door data. Score 5 (TOP_LOBBIED). Gets opposition dirt in his email.

vice_chairs.name: Simon-Pierre Savard-Tremblay
vice_chairs.note: Bloc SWING VOTE on NDDN. His vote decides whether CFNIS study passes 5-4 or fails 4-5.

members.name: Cheryl Gallant
members.note: Most outspoken CPC critic of military leadership. Will champion P5.

members.name: Jeff Kibble
members.note: CLEAN CPC on NDDN. Additional ally candidate.

vote_math.note: 4 CPC + 1 Bloc = 5 vs 4 Liberal (chair only votes to break ties). Bloc is the SWING VOTE. If Savard-Tremblay supports a CFNIS study, it passes.

campaign_action.phase_4_study: Request NDDN study on CFNIS oversight independence (P5). Bezan as vice-chair can formally propose the study. CPC members will vote yes because it exposes military leadership failures. Bloc swing vote: frame as 'Quebec soldiers deserve independent oversight.'
campaign_action.target_mp: James Bezan — send him the CFNIS command dossier + revolving door analysis (Pratt 408 DND comms). He's been CPC defence critic for years and already opposes Liberal procurement.
campaign_action.secondary_target: Cheryl Gallant — most outspoken CPC critic of military leadership. She will champion P5 independently.
campaign_action.bloc_swing: Simon-Pierre Savard-Tremblay — send the CFNIS data with Quebec angle. 'Quebec families in the military deserve independent oversight, not a self-investigating chain of command.'

cross_committee_strategy.simultaneous_requests: File ETHI and NDDN study requests in the SAME week (Phase 4, Week 4-6). Two committee studies running simultaneously creates maximum media coverage and makes it harder to bury either one.
cross_committee_strategy.ethi_feeds_nddn: ETHI lobbying study exposes Pratt revolving door → feeds into NDDN oversight study. The committees reinforce each other.
cross_committee_strategy.bloc_is_key: Bloc holds swing vote on NDDN and supports ETHI opposition majority. Blanchet as kingmaker can make both studies happen as price of Liberal confidence. ONE conversation with Blanchet unlocks both committees.
